english.title: Use on a road a wheeled vehicle drawing a trailer / trailers which exceeded the permitted number
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a wheeled vehicle, namely

(A)_[a straddle carrier]_
(B)_[an invalid carriage]_
(C)_[an articulated bus]_
(D)_[a bus not being articulated or a mini bus ]_
(E)_[a locomotive]_
(F)_[a motor tractor]_
(G)_[a motor car]_
(H)_[a heavy motor car]_
(I)_[an agricultural vehicle]_

**(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), drawing
